note: Remote Black Hills NF campground in a spruce canyon along Castle Creek. The Forest Service says the last 8 miles on FSR 181 from Castleton are rough and narrow; recreation.gov also gives a shorter approach from Rochford (South Rochford Road, then FSR 181 and 181.1C for 2.5 miles). No drinking water. --Claude
summary: rec.gov (concession, ExplorUS) + FS page read: 9 FCFS RV non-electric drive-in sites, 45-ft spurs, $24 (was $22) May 15-Sep 30, free off-season; no potable water, vault toilet. Fees, sites, facilities, hookups, booking, season written; note rewritten (the 'high-clearance recommended' wording is on no agency page).
flags: ACCESS (not a drop): the FS page says only 'Last 8 miles on 181 is rough and narrow' - no 4WD/high-clearance requirement or recommendation and no rig restriction on the FS page or on recreation.gov. The old note's 'high-clearance recommended' is not on any agency page read, so the rewritten note quotes the FS wording instead. Reviewer may want to know a rough 8-mile gravel approach is involved.
FEES: stored $22 -> $24 (rec.gov WalkInStandard, 2026 and 2027). Second vehicle $6/night (ExplorUS) written as fees.extra_vehicle.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (not changed): rec.gov tags all 9 sites 'Proximity to Water: Riverfront' and 'Creek Access', and the FS layout map draws sites 3-9 right beside a small side stream. The stream is a small creek (well under 30 m), so creekside at most, and on Esri imagery 2026-11-21 the whole site string sits under continuous spruce canopy with the water invisible - under the canopy rule this is a view at best and there is no creek-view value, so not waterfront stays.
PIN: 44.07920,-103.72790 is ~120 m SW of the rec.gov site centroid (~44.0802,-103.7273) - inside the site string near site 8/9; fine.
PHONE: (605) 343-1567 (Mystic Ranger District, rec.gov facility phone and FS page) - keep. The concessionaire's line on rec.gov is (661) 702-1420. WEBSITE: both links live - keep.
